description: PostgreSQL 18 multidimensional array bounds, nulls, empty arrays, rectangular validation, and rank limits
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_array_rank (ordinary INT4[], matrix INT4[2][3], labels TEXT[4]);

SELECT a.attname, a.attndims, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_array_rank' AND a.attnum > 0 ORDER BY a.attnum;
SELECT '[0:1][5:6]={{1,2},{3,4}}'::int4[] AS matrix, array_dims('[0:1][5:6]={{1,2},{3,4}}'::int4[]) AS dimensions, '{1,NULL,3}'::int4[] AS nulls, '{}'::int4[] AS empty;
